follow-on: the new assertion assert "3" in message is a bare substring of the whole error string, so any coincidental digit 3 (a pid, a path) would satisfy it where the intended check is the exit status; asserting the "exit status 3" clause would pin it to the field the test means.

item_verdicts.diff: read 532a5f63 against its parent 907f23aa at head and against base 27c67a3a; the head commit captures the intermediate's stderr (stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL changed to subprocess.PIPE, read with communicate), appends its exit status and last three stderr lines to the no-pid CrewError through a new _intermediate_failure_detail helper (dispatch.py:7193), strengthens test_launcher_that_reports_no_pid_is_refused to assert the text and the status reach the error (:273-289), and rewrites the evidence fragment to the shipped fresh-interpreter mechanism; net +65/-21 across three paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is asserted directly in tests/test_supervisor_outlives_its_launcher.py — the supervisor's ppid differs from the launcher's (:224), its pgrp and session both equal its own pid (:231), it survives a SIGKILL of the launcher's whole process tree (:238), it inherits none of the launcher's descriptors with a positive control that the pipe is live in the launcher (test_supervisor_inherits_no_launcher_descriptor :256-270), and an intermediate that writes to stderr and exits without a pid has that text and status in the refusal (:273-289); the reviewer re-ran that file plus the two dispatch test files at head in a /tmp scratch tree: 18 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make reckon.crew.dispatch._start_supervisor detach the per-run supervisor from the process that launched it; at head 532a5f63 _start_supervisor (dispatch.py:7123) reaches _spawn_detached_supervisor (dispatch.py:7157) from the non-fleet branch (dispatch.py:7152), which starts a fresh interpreter subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", _SUPERVISOR_LAUNCHER_SOURCE]) with close_fds=True, hands it the supervisor argv and stderr path as JSON on stdin, and reads back the pid the intermediate prints; the intermediate starts the supervisor with start_new_session=True and exits at once, so the supervisor is reparented away from the launcher and leads its own session and process group; _confirm_supervisor_survived still runs on the returned pid (dispatch.py:7153) and the fleet batch-step path (dispatch.py:7143-7150) is unchanged.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, five commits named (149d3c29, 907f23aa, d5e8dd05, 55c35193, 532a5f63), the gate counts (5/7/6 passed) with gate.log, dispatch-returns.log and fleet-spawns.log, two negative controls and a regression log recorded, and evidence_inputs disclosing the two out-of-fence test edits; the manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite pair, so the required added-failure derivation is the reviewer's, and its own gate logs name revision 907f23aa (the parent of head 532a5f63), not the final head.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_supervisor_outlives_its_launcher.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk/supervisor-outlives-its-launcher.html and docs/figures/a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk/supervisor-outlives-its-launcher; the address touches the first three inside the grant, but also tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py and tests/test_dispatch_spawns_through_the_fleet.py outside it (disclosed in evidence_inputs and the fragment as coordinator-directed rather than hidden), and the declared figures path was never produced.

justifications.durability: the guards assert the kernel's own record (/proc/<pid>/stat for ppid, pgrp and session; /proc/<pid>/fd for descriptors) with a positive control that the pipe is live in the launcher, and the run's negative control restoring the single Popen reddens exactly the parent-pid and tree-kill assertions; the new no-pid refusal is tested and the reviewer confirmed the guard fires — dropping the stderr detail from dispatch.py:7188 reddens test_launcher_that_reports_no_pid_is_refused on assert "no supervisor argv" in message (1 failed, EXIT=1) — docked one because the same case's assert "3" in message is a bare substring a coincidental digit would satisfy.
justifications.evidence: the gate was reproduced independently at head — tests/test_supervisor_outlives_its_launcher.py plus tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py plus tests/test_dispatch_spawns_through_the_fleet.py gave 18 passed EXIT=0 in /tmp/rev-532a5f63 — and the base arm (27c67a3a, 13 passed EXIT=0) leaves no failure present at head and absent at base, so added_failure_count is 0 by the reviewer's arms; docked because the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite pair so that derivation is the reviewer's, and the run's own gate logs name revision 907f23aa, the parent of head, so they do not certify the head commit.
justifications.fit: helpers are named by mechanism (_spawn_detached_supervisor, _intermediate_failure_detail, _SUPERVISOR_LAUNCHER_SOURCE; no plan or ticket label), the fresh-interpreter choice and close_fds are each explained in the docstring (dispatch.py:7158-7172), the docstrings state the why, and commit bodies are substantive with no trailer; deducted for the declared figure path being produced as no figure and the fragment file ending without a trailing newline.
justifications.goal_fidelity: at head 532a5f63 _start_supervisor (dispatch.py:7123) starts the supervisor through _spawn_detached_supervisor (dispatch.py:7157), whose fresh-interpreter intermediate starts it with start_new_session=True and exits at once so the launcher is never its parent while the supervisor's own pid is returned and _confirm_supervisor_survived still runs on it (dispatch.py:7153); the parent-pid assertion (tests/test_supervisor_outlives_its_launcher.py:224) is reddened by the run's single-Popen control, so the stated goal is fully met.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five commits touch the declared reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_supervisor_outlives_its_launcher.py and the evidence fragment, but also tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py and tests/test_dispatch_spawns_through_the_fleet.py, which are outside the node's declared write paths (disclosed in evidence_inputs and the fragment as coordinator-directed rather than hidden), and the declared figures path was left unused; commit subjects and bodies carry no plan or ticket label and no AI trailer, checked at every commit.
